scope: Official native parser and model update; neutral, every individual parameter minimum/maximum, head-angle combinations, closed eyes with open mouth, and, when both standard mouth parameters exist, 125 mouth form/open combinations with available head/body/eye inputs normalized to their declared ranges. Checks indices, UVs, finite vertices, opacity range and actual parameter effects. Reports triangle changes and mouth opacities without assuming a character-specific crossfade formula; visible seams require texture/alpha and rendered-image review. Does not assess artistic quality or VTube Studio tracking.
